# Psalm 115 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Not to-us O-YHWH, not to-us, but to-your-name give glory, on-account-of your-steadfast-love, on-account-of your-faithfulness.

**2** Why should-say the-nations, 'Where now their-God?'

**3** And-our-God in-the-heavens; all which he-pleased he-has-done.

**4** Their-idols silver and-gold, work-of hands-of man.

**5** Mouth to-them and-not they-speak; eyes to-them and-not they-see.

**6** Ears to-them and-not they-hear; nose to-them and-not they-smell.

**7** Their-hands and-not they-feel; their-feet and-not they-walk; not they-make-a-sound in-their-throat.

**8** Like-them will-be those-making-them, all who trusts in-them.

**9** O-Israel trust in-YHWH; their-help and-their-shield he.

**10** O-house-of Aaron trust in-YHWH; their-help and-their-shield he.

**11** Fearers-of YHWH trust in-YHWH; their-help and-their-shield he.

**12** YHWH has-remembered-us, he-will-bless; he-will-bless the-house-of Israel; he-will-bless the-house-of Aaron.

**13** He-will-bless the-fearers-of YHWH, the-small with the-great.

**14** May-add YHWH upon-you, upon-you and-upon your-children.

**15** Blessed you to-YHWH, maker-of heaven and-earth.

**16** The-heavens the-heavens to-YHWH, and-the-earth he-has-given to-sons-of man.

**17** Not the-dead praise Yah, and-not all going-down to-silence.

**18** And-we will-bless Yah from-now and-to forever. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **115:8**: 'Like-them will-be those-making-them' — the most devastating critique of idolatry: worshippers become as senseless as their idols.

- **115:16**: 'The-earth he-has-given to-sons-of man' — divine delegation of earthly stewardship; heaven is God's realm, earth is humanity's trust.

— EMET
